claims.quote: Described from "Stanley Pool", now known as Pool Malebo, a lake-like widening of the Congo River in western-central Africa on the border of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire) and the Republic of the Congo between their respective capital cities of Kinshasa and Brazzaville.
